BESECURE_SCAN_ID.description: Optional beSecure scan ID to import. When set, only that scan's report (/api/scan/report/{id}) is pulled. When omitted, /api/scan/list is enumerated and every visible scan's report is imported.

name: besecure
title: Beyond Security beSecure
description: Beyond Security beSecure (AVDS) importer. Lists scans via /api/scan/list and pulls per-scan reports via /api/scan/report/{id}; emits one Faraday host per scanned target with its vulnerabilities attached. Severity is normalised from beSecure's string severities (informational/low/medium/high/critical), its numeric risk levels (1=info ... 5=critical), or, when only a CVSS score is provided, bucketed via the CVSS v3 ranges. Auth is HTTP Basic — set BESECURE_USER / BESECURE_PASSWORD and BESECURE_HOST to the appliance base URL.
